rationale: Inner1 carries grounded fill plus reviewed low-current/control escapes. The 6.17 mm A_MINUS bridge is screened at phase current on minimum 17.5 um copper. Every USB trunk stays on an outer layer with its adjacent grounded reference geometrically verified. Independent continuity, copper/thermal and Gerber audits remain mandatory. PD_VBUS on inner1 is limited to the physically cut-verified high-value voltage-divider branch; its full-power rail stays on reviewed power layers.
